x: In these events, N. Day and Bob Littler, T.V.H., both running for Belgrave, also scored points; as did George Morris in the 440 yards, in which Len Marchant scored a grand win, running in the outside lane, to record undoubtedly his fastest 440 yards.
Congrats, and may your double life be long and happy. N.

Wilson had an easy win in the 880 Yards and Syd Jarlett beat Norman Day in very good time for the 440 Yards. Young Clay scored a fine sprint double, and we were glad to see Willie Nankeville, our young Southern Junior Champion turning out again, although not over his usual distance.
